sentence: Trump said U.S. and Iranian officials met shortly after he warned in his U.N. address that he may “annihilate” the Islamic Republic if a deal isn't reached soon to end the war.
Trump told reporters that the talks took place but gave no details beyond describing “a very good meeting.”
Separately, U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Trump is open to meeting with Iran’s president, Masoud Pezeshkian, while he’s in New York for the General Assembly.
Iran’s joint military command responded to Trump’s threat in a statement, calling it “domestic propaganda” rather than reflecting realities on the ground.
It said repeated U.S. threats showed “strategic desperation,” and warned that Iran is prepared to “inflict even more severe, crushing, and unpredictable blows” to the U.S. and Israel.
